description: Per-character sound bundle: cue sheets to preload, footstep type, and the voice-group set / voice-group ID lists used for battle and system lines.

Id.technical: FName primary key. Characters resolve it from CharacterVariation.Id_CharacterSound (with an optional setup override), shikigami from Shikigami.Id_CharacterSound, sequencer NPCs from their model name, and UGameSoundVoicePlayer from a supplied variation ID. Finders walk DTM.CharacterSoundDataTables in order and return the first typed row. Export spells it ID.

CueSheetName.simple: Cue sheets belonging to this character/variation that must be resident.
CueSheetName.technical: TArray<FName> indexed in parallel with other per-character audio lookups but consumed mainly as a preload list: battle-asset collection appends every entry after the CharacterVariation join, and the situation-overview widget collects non-None entries for LoadCueSheets/UnloadCueSheets and a loaded-sheet readiness check. Exported rows commonly have a character sheet plus a None placeholder, which consumers do not always filter (BattleAssets_DoCueSheets appends verbatim; the overview filters None).

FootstepType.simple: Which family of footstep sounds the actor uses.
FootstepType.technical: EGameFootstepType (None default; ShoesMan, ShoesWoman, BareFoot, Zori, Gorilla, Totality, Invalid). AGameCharacter::GetFootstepType and AGameShikigami::GetFootstepType return it as uint8; sequencer NPC lookup returns the row value directly. Footstep anim notifies convert it with GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex (enum value - 1) to index MapGround.Id_SoundEffect_Footstep, so None maps to -1 and selects nothing. The exported 56 rows use ShoesMan, ShoesWoman and Zori.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroupSet.simple: Candidate CharacterVoiceGroupSet IDs for normal, alternate and low-HP voice sets.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroupSet.technical: TArray<FName> returned by ActionController slot 90. AGameCharacter::FindCharacterVoiceGroupSetRow selects index by Mode: mode 1 uses the saved NormalAttackVoiceIndex, mode 2 uses CursedEnergyAttackVoiceIndex, and a low-HP check forces Mode 3 (array index 3 when Mode is used directly). None IDs and out-of-range indices resolve to no row. Exported rows use four entries such as CP_010, CP_010_TYPEA, CP_010_TYPEB, CP_010_PINCH.

Id_VoiceGroup.simple: VoiceGroup IDs for system/menu/result lines, indexed by request kind.
Id_VoiceGroup.technical: TArray<FName>. UGameSoundVoicePlayer::PlayCharacterVoice takes a GroupKind, computes GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex(GroupKind) = GroupKind - 1, reads Id_VoiceGroup[that index] without a bounds check, then resolves a VoiceGroup row and picks a random non-None entry from its Id_Voice. Callers use values such as 1 (character select), 3 (result/menu), 4-5 (lobby), 13-15 (rank/result) and 17 (rematch). None IDs stop the lookup because bCheckNone=true.

notes: Loaded as a 'DataTable' primary asset named CharacterSoundDataTable into DTM.CharacterSoundDataTables (+0x510). Character setup resolves the row from the selected variation and caches it at AGameCharacter+0x3D0; a failed resolution fails the whole row setup.

This row is a hub, not a leaf: Id_CharacterVoiceGroupSet joins to CharacterVoiceGroupSetDataTable, Id_VoiceGroup joins to VoiceGroupDataTable, FootstepType joins indirectly through MapGround.Id_SoundEffect_Footstep to SoundEffectDataTable, and CueSheetName names loadable CRI sheets.
The exported 56 rows are the available content only; no completeness claim is made for retail or Blueprint references.
Source files are reconstructions of the retail binary (retail RVAs are recorded inline); no editor or network processing was used for this documentation.

usages.detail: Shared typed row finder over CharacterSound tables.
Resolves and caches the character's sound row during setup.
Collects CueSheetName entries for battle preloading.
Collects and loads cue sheets for the situation-overview characters.
Exposes FootstepType to animation notifies and sequencer helpers.
Exposes Id_CharacterVoiceGroupSet to the action voice system.
Resolves Id_VoiceGroup and queues a random voice from it.
Looks up footstep type by NPC model name.
